subject: Re: KeyPose status: scope decision for the July readout
body:
Team,

Decisions for the final stretch.

1) Scope: the partner readout on Jul 15 covers bottle-like SKUs only. The heart-category ambiguity finding goes in the appendix as a known limitation — better we name it than they discover it. Symmetric-object keypoint disambiguation becomes a Q3 line item.

2) Fine-tune results on the pilot capture came in Monday: 1.1mm mean keypoint error on the two tumblers, 1.6mm on the jar. That clears the 2mm gripper tolerance, so the end-to-end pick demo is a go.

3) Wanjiru — please confirm this week that the re-ingest is tracking to our Jul 17 target. I don't want the freeze week turning into a fire drill.

Also flagging for capacity planning: Q3 OKRs locked Jun 26 and this track is in the vision portfolio commitments, so the readout deck goes to Hana as well.

Lucia
